summary: Risk-off, geopolitics-first session: US declared the Iran ceasefire over and struck 80+ targets after Hormuz tanker attacks, spiking WTI +3.32% and the 10yr to 4.57%. Financials cracked (SYF -9.61%) and homebuilders were crushed; NDX held green (+0.27%) only on a narrow mega-cap chip bounce as SPX breadth ran 112/388. NDX regime downgraded to Neutral Bull.
